heroHeadline: Day 103: World Cup T-6 Days; Mexico-FIFA Final Security Review; OCCRP Documents CJNG Algorithm Warfare; El Sapo at Large
heroSubtitle: Day 103 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). MEXICO-FIFA FINAL SECURITY REVIEW (June 5): Mexican security authorities met FIFA officials in a final pre-tournament security assessment — Plan Kukulkan at peak deployment with 99,000+ personnel. Guadalajara flagged as CJNG's primary risk nexus for 4 group-stage matches beginning June 15. OCCRP ALGORITHM WARFARE INVESTIGATION (June 2026): 'Fear Is the Message' — OCCRP documented how CJNG weaponized social media algorithms to psychologically paralyze Mexican society, businesses, and governments without additional gunmen — a force-multiplication doctrine active throughout the post-Mencho succession period. WORLD CUP T-6 DAYS: FIFA World Cup 2026 opens in 6 days (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Plan Kukulkan deployment locked in: 20,000 Armed Forces, 55,000 federal/state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft/drones, anti-drone systems operational at all three Mexican venues. CJNG BLACKOUT ONGOING: CJNG's internal directive to avoid high-visibility violence during the World Cup window remains in effect — analysts assess as temporary calculus; post-tournament return to baseline expected. 8-NATION TRAVEL WARNING CLUSTER: US, Canada, UK, Australia, Germany, France, New Zealand, and Japan all issued heightened Mexico travel advisories for World Cup visitors. CJNG NC SENTENCING (June 3): Elian Rene Fabian Valladolid sentenced to 262 months for leading a CJNG-linked fentanyl cell in North Carolina — DOJ domestic enforcement campaign continues post-Mencho. CJNG CBP BOUNTIES (HSToday June 2026): CJNG authorized bounties on U.S. CBP agents via drone strikes and direct gunfire. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 103: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — pre-June 11 capture objective passed feasible window. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 27: 27 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9); no confirmed successor plaza boss. CJNG JUNE ATTACK SURGE: 324 attacks in June 2026 alone (of 756 total Feb–June) — highest monthly total of the post-Mencho period. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU: 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives across 10 Michoacán municipalities. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 103): Ongoing — 'coordination without subordination' Mullin-Sheinbaum framework active; June bilateral meeting pending. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
